name: dilated_causal_conv
description: Causal convolution with exponentially increasing dilation factors (2^i), giving O(log T) receptive field growth per layer.

name: gated_activation
description: Sigmoid-gated element-wise multiplication of two conv branches (tanh * sigmoid), enabling selective signal modulation.

name: skip_connection
description: Additive residual path bypassing one or more layers, preserving gradient flow and enabling multi-scale feature aggregation.

name: positional_encoding
description: Sinusoidal or learned position embeddings injected into the representation to encode temporal order.

name: multi_head_attention
description: Parallel self-attention heads computing global pairwise token interactions. O(T^2) memory.

name: encoder_decoder
description: Symmetric architecture that compresses input to a bottleneck representation then reconstructs, with skip connections between matched levels.

name: lstm_cell
description: Long Short-Term Memory recurrent cell with forget/input/output gates for sequential state compression.

name: spectral_conv
description: Learnable complex-valued weights applied in Fourier domain (RFFT), processing all frequency bins directly.

name: static_v_gate
description: User-controlled per-frequency gate vector (v_k in [0,1]) that blends spectral and bypass paths, encoding domain knowledge about signal bands.

name: bottleneck_compression
description: Narrow hidden layer that forces the network to learn a compressed representation of the full input segment.

name: embedding_layer
description: Lookup table mapping discrete integer ADC values (0-255) to dense vector representations.

name: receptive_field
description: How far back in time the model can see per layer stack — wider receptive field enables better low-frequency signal capture.

name: frequency_resolution
description: The model's ability to distinguish and process different frequency bands in the signal independently.

name: selective_frequency_processing
description: Ability to attenuate or amplify specific frequency bands independently, rather than treating the spectrum uniformly.

name: gradient_flow
description: Ease of gradient propagation during backpropagation — skip connections and residual paths prevent vanishing gradients in deep architectures.

name: parameter_efficiency
description: Achieving comparable denoising performance with fewer trainable parameters — important for VRAM budget and generalization.

name: long_range_dependency
description: Model's capacity to capture correlations across distant timesteps — critical for low-frequency signal recovery.

name: multi_scale_aggregation
description: Combining features from multiple temporal resolutions — coarse features capture trends, fine features capture transients.

name: domain_knowledge_injection
description: Encoding known physics or signal properties directly into the architecture, rather than learning them from data alone.

name: temporal_alignment
description: Maintaining phase-coherent correspondence between input and output timesteps across all processing stages.

name: sequential_processing
description: Processing the signal strictly left-to-right with hidden state accumulation — enables streaming but limits parallelism.
